answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a cedar bet on surviving 99 epochs of grading, and every shale settlement recomputes the prism schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 99 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
